items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I had Claude Hopkins... I had drummer, Marcus Foster on Drums... Herman Autrey on trumpet. And so the four would finally get down

ctx.x: Piano, well, when I get ready to come up I'd ask him would he come up with me, and I told him, I said well who have you got on the group? I said well I've got so and so and so and so. I had Claude Hopkins. Claude Hopkins would go on piano. I said yes, and I had drummer,
Marcus Foster on Drums, hmmmmm, ah, trying to think of who did we have on -- Herman Autrey on trumpet. And so the four would finally get down, three pieces, and who the hell did we have on bass?
